title: Language Models Might Not Understand You: Evaluating Theory of Mind via Story Prompting

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on synthetic Theory of Mind (ToM) story prompts by varying the 'mislead distance' (the number of events between a character's last observation of a target and the target's final movement) to test if models disproportionately rely on the most recent context rather than correctly tracking the character's mental state.
